props.name: messageSource
props.comment: The field printed as the entry's text; a dotted path reads a nested value.

props.name: timestampSource
props.comment: The field holding the entry's date. An invalid or missing date leaves the time out.

props.name: userSource
props.comment: The field holding who did it. Without it, or with no value, the entry shows no user.

props.name: iconSource
props.comment: The field whose value picks an entry of `icons`.

props.name: icons
props.comment: Icons by the value of `iconSource`. An entry with no match shows a clock.

slots.name: loading
slots.comment: Rendered while the list is pending, in place of `SimpleListLoading`.

slots.name: empty
slots.comment: Rendered with no records, in place of the translated "No activity yet".
